mapper.sql: p.id, p.title, p.description, p.price, p.original_price, p.category_id, p.seller_id, p.cover, p.condition_level, p.status, p.view_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at, c.name AS category_name, u.nickname AS seller_nickname, u.avatar AS seller_avatar

where.if: AND (p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR p.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM products p LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = p.seller_id
ORDER BY p.price ASC, p.id DESC ORDER BY p.price DESC, p.id DESC ORDER BY p.view_count DESC, p.id DESC ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}

SELECT
FROM products p LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = p.seller_id WHERE p.status = 'ON_SALE' ORDER BY p.view_count DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT
FROM products p LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = p.seller_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (title, description, price, original_price, category_id, seller_id, cover, condition_level, status, view_count) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{price}, #{originalPrice}, #{categoryId}, #{sellerId}, #{cover}, #{conditionLevel}, #{status}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, original_price = #{originalPrice}, category_id = #{categoryId}, cover = #{cover}, condition_level = #{conditionLevel}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND seller_id = #{sellerId}
UPDATE products SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE products SET status = 'LOCKED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ON_SALE'
